content.title: TreeHouse Foods to Be Acquired in $2.9 Billion Take-Private Deal. The Stock Surges.
content.summary: TreeHouse Foods  said Monday it had agreed to be taken private by Investindustrial, a European investment firm, in an all-cash transaction that values the food processing company at $2.9 billion.  Under the terms of the deal,  TreeHouse Foods  shareholders will receive $22.50 a share in cash for each share of common stock owned at closing, representing an equity value of $1.2 billion.  Holders also will receive one contingent value right per share, which will allow them to receive proceeds from litigation relating to part of TreeHouse Foods’ coffee business.

content.title: Why Are TreeHouse Foods (THS) Shares Soaring Today
content.summary: Shares of private label food company TreeHouse Foods (NYSE:THS) jumped 23.2% in the afternoon session after it agreed to be acquired by the European private equity firm Investindustrial in an all-cash deal valued at approximately $2.9 billion. Under the terms of the agreement, TreeHouse Foods shareholders received $22.50 in cash for each share of common stock, a substantial premium.
